Container.Name: airtag-map
Container.Overview: Experimentell karta for dina egna AirTags och Hitta-foremal. Anvand imagen fran GitHub Container Registry efter att Actions-bygget lyckats. Apple-inloggning sker inne i appen. Porten binds till 127.0.0.1:8787; oppna via SSH-tunnel eller konfigurera HTTPS-proxy. Docker-bygget och verklig Apple-atkomst ar inte verifierade.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Apple sessions, accessory keys and last locations. Protect this directory and backups.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: App login password, not your Apple password. Username: admin. Choose a separate random password of at least 24 characters.

Config.Name: Data directory inside container
Config.Description: Keep /data unless also changing the path mapping.

Config.Name: Anisette v3 server
Config.Description: Third-party authentication metadata service used by the exporter.
